verdict.rationale: A government business-filing and records portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chatbot, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only conventional web forms for search, filing, and ordering behind a credential login, with no natural-language command interface, assistant, or conversational layer documented. The probes also show bot-walled front doors (Radware CAPTCHA), which undercut agent-driven operation rather than support it.
